API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIProvisioningGet Public Account Details By Id
Get Public Account Details By Id
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudAccountDetails/:id

Gets the public (Cloud Connector) cloud account information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the public cloud account.

QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Internal ID of public cloud account/subscription.

accountId
string

Account or subscription ID of public cloud account.

platformId
string

Public cloud platform (AWS or Azure).

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE]
